name: Portainer
description: Browse Docker and Kubernetes Portainer environments, stacks or namespaces and containers from DBX, inspect resource usage and read container logs, with MCP tools for AI clients.
releaseNotes: Adds Kubernetes environment support with a namespace filter and previous-container logs, reconnects the workbench session automatically, and keeps Docker environments and MCP tools working.

zh-CN.name: Portainer
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 中浏览 Portainer 的 Docker 与 Kubernetes 环境、堆栈或命名空间与容器，查看资源占用并阅读容器日志，同时向 AI 客户端提供 MCP 工具。
